text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—The 'Nikkei Shinshun Hai'. That was clearly
a stage set for a 'pursuit battle',
borne purely out of Rulership's sheer will."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —Ruler, let me ask you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Why go out of your way
to enter the Nikkei Shinshun Hai?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Heh... Wondering why I'd go out of my way, are you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is no doubt that this is
a grueling race schedule for Rulership.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Missing the chance to race against you at the Arima Kinen
left a really bad taste in my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: —Is just that not enough?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...I don't think it's a lie. But if it was just about
crossing swords, it could have been further down the road.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
She must have some deep scheme in mind.
Just what could she be considering?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, truthfully...
After running the Challenge Cup last year—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I was told.
By my mentor, Air Groove-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ruler, about your classmate Rose Kingdom...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
In the past, I once fought with glory on the line
against the House of Roses.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I was also told the full details of what happened back then.
According to what they said...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"The stage was the 'Oaks'.
Air Groove-san was the undisputed favorite."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yet there was one Umamusume
who bravely took on the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Rose Family Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
At last... I've arrived.
The stage of the GⅠ Eight Major Races...

text_block_list.name: Rose Family Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "I shall certainly dye these Oaks in a brilliant rose color!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That challenger was an Umamusume of the Clan of Roses,
running in her very first Eight Major Race.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Air Groove!
Across time, mother and daughter have woven their dreams upon the turf!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
There was no way the great Air Groove-san could lose.
The clash between the two houses—the Academy and the House of Roses—ended in a landslide victory for the Academy.

text_block_list.name: Rose Family Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Right now... I couldn't match up to them...
But someday, I definitely will...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
And so, the cherished dream of the Rose clan
was passed down to the next generation...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
And now, transcending time—
you and I stand right here.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I have no interest in old grudges, but...
you see things differently, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "I thought it was the perfect stage. After all, a 1v1 match rather than a 4-player free-for-all is—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It easily clears away a lot of things.
Especially if you're prone to falling into zero-sum thinking.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I see... You did this... for my sake...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, don't get the wrong idea.
I'm a gamer. I never make a move out of pure goodwill.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I have my own reasons.
Reasons that are different from yours.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us settle it upon the board.
—Our unforgettable past, that is.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, Ruler, I...
don't hold a grudge.
What I feel is simply—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It's "respect."
For your family, who has taken root in this country and nurtured Umamusume since long ago.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"And for standing tall as a wall
before my clan."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I wish to repay that debt of gratitude by achieving greatness—by showing that we, who were once mere buds, have fully blossomed.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Once again, I ask to test myself against you.
—Rulership.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's make it an entertaining game.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The past of the school and the Rose Clan has been revealed.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The game begins. A clash of fated strength between those who carry on that spirit across time.
